findings.description: Cluster of thin scratches and scuff lines on the right half of the panel surface, including vertical and short diagonal marks.
Central irregular scuff patch with intersecting faint scratch-like lines.
Faint linear marks on the left-central area of the panel surface.
Several thin scratches near the top end of the vertically oriented panel.
Small cluster of short linear scuff marks on the upper-middle left side.
Irregular smudged scratch patch in the middle of the panel.
Linear scuff marks near the bottom end of the panel.
Faint linear marks on the left-central region of the panel.
Central scuff patch with irregular scratch-like texture.
Cluster of scratches and scuff lines on the right half of the panel.
Cluster of thin scratches and linear scuff marks on the left half of the panel.

Cluster of linear scuff marks and scratches on the lower half of the vertically oriented panel.

observations.note: Front-facing view; surface scratches and scuff marks are visible across the panel, especially on the right half and center.
Vertical view of the same panel; scratches near top, middle and bottom are visible, though some areas are slightly foreshortened.
Angled horizontal view; surface marks on the right half and center are discernible with moderate contrast.
Angled horizontal view from the opposite side; left-half scratches and central scuff patch are visible.
Vertical view; lower-half linear marks and mid-panel scuff are visible, with mild reflection on the surface.

limitations: Only the visible external surfaces are inspected; internal damage or unphotographed sides cannot be assessed.
Surface detail is limited to photographic resolution and contrast; very shallow or low-contrast marks may be underestimated.
No scale reference is provided, so dimensions or depth of scratches cannot be determined.
Some marks may be surface smudges rather than true scratches, but they are recorded as visible linear traces.
